office_does: District Court judges hear misdemeanor and gross misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil suits up to $100,000, small claims, protection orders and felony first appearances for Clark County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Megan D. Peyton is the only candidate for Department 5, on the ballot for both the short and the full four-year term.

candidates.summary: Appointed by the Clark County Council and on the District Court bench since January 2026, after a career in indigent defense; on the ballot for the short and full term. The only candidate.
